items.problem: Ported UWP code using Windows.UI.Colors / Windows.UI.ColorHelper fails to build with CS0234 because those helper classes moved to Microsoft.UI, but the bootstrap namespace mass-rewrite only handles Windows.UI.Xaml.
items.evidence: session-log.txt:2231-2232 CS0234 'Colors does not exist in namespace Windows.UI' at MainPage.xaml.cs(110,63)/(113,63); manual fix at 2284-2287.
items.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 §3 rewrites only 'Windows.UI.Xaml'; the non-Xaml helper classes that also relocated to Microsoft.UI are never rewritten and no residue rule flags them.
items.change: Added a bootstrap rewrite step (§3a) mapping Windows.UI.Colors -> Microsoft.UI.Colors and Windows.UI.ColorHelper -> Microsoft.UI.ColorHelper with a trailing \b so the Windows.UI.Color struct is preserved.
items.expected_effect: Named-color brushes and ColorHelper calls compile immediately after bootstrap; no CS0234 build round-trip.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run of any color-using UWP app, the ported source contains Microsoft.UI.Colors (not Windows.UI.Colors) after Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1, and dotnet build emits no CS0234 for Colors/ColorHelper.

items.problem: The validator's residue grep does not catch leftover Windows.UI.Colors/ColorHelper if the bootstrap is skipped or the agent re-introduces them by hand.
items.evidence: unsupported-api-inventory.json residueOnly previously covered only Windows.UI.Xaml* / UWP csproj markers.
items.root_cause: No backstop rule for the moved non-Xaml helper classes.
items.change: Added a residueOnly pattern 'Windows\.UI\.Colors\b|Windows\.UI\.ColorHelper\b' so Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 fails fast on any leftover (word-boundary keeps the Color struct exempt).
items.expected_effect: Validator flags any remaining Windows.UI.Colors/ColorHelper before the build, pointing the agent at the fix.
items.falsifiable_check: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 reports a residue hit if a file still contains Windows.UI.Colors, and passes once rewritten.

items.problem: The namespace mapping table lists Windows.UI.Colors among the Windows.UI.Xaml.* namespace moves without warning that the Windows.UI.Color struct (and Point/Size/Rect) do NOT move, inviting either a missed rewrite or an over-broad Windows.UI->Microsoft.UI replace.
items.evidence: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md:112 inside the 'all Windows.UI.Xaml.* move' table; dev-agent kept Windows.UI.Colors and hit CS0234.
items.change: Added a ColorHelper row and a caveat blockquote clarifying that only Colors/ColorHelper move while the Color struct and Point/Size/Rect stay — never do a blanket Windows.UI->Microsoft.UI replace.
items.expected_effect: If the agent hand-edits colors (bootstrap not run on a file), it applies the correct targeted rewrite instead of over/under-rewriting.
items.falsifiable_check: Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 for the namespace section surfaces the caveat; manual color rewrites use Microsoft.UI.Colors while leaving Windows.UI.Color intact.
